# Levels

Photo-editor levels: stretch the tones between an input black and white point, bend the midtones with gamma, and remap to an output range, for all channels or one.

<EffectDemo effect="levels" />

## Usage

```ts
import { EffectComposer } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { levels } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/levels';

const composer = new EffectComposer(renderer);
composer.setScene(scene, camera);
composer.add(levels({ preset: 'contrast' }));
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => composer.render());
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.inputBlack = 0`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling; parameters marked _structural_ recompile the pass that contains the effect.

## Parameters

| Parameter                | Type                                | Default | Range   | Description                                                          |
| ------------------------ | ----------------------------------- | ------- | ------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `inputBlack`             | number                              | `0`     | 0 – 0.9 | Input value that becomes black; darker values clip.                  |
| `inputWhite`             | number                              | `1`     | 0.1 – 1 | Input value that becomes white; brighter values stay brighter.       |
| `gamma`                  | number                              | `1`     | 0.2 – 4 | Midtone gamma: above 1 brightens the midtones, below 1 darkens them. |
| `outputBlack`            | number                              | `0`     | 0 – 0.9 | Output value for black; raise it for a faded, matte look.            |
| `outputWhite`            | number                              | `1`     | 0.1 – 1 | Output value for white.                                              |
| `channel` _(structural)_ | 'rgb' \| 'red' \| 'green' \| 'blue' | `'rgb'` |         | Adjust every channel together, or only one.                          |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset     | Settings                                 |
| ---------- | ---------------------------------------- |
| `contrast` | `inputBlack: 0.06`, `inputWhite: 0.94`   |
| `matte`    | `outputBlack: 0.08`, `outputWhite: 0.95` |
| `brighten` | `gamma: 1.4`                             |
| `crush`    | `inputBlack: 0.15`, `gamma: 0.85`        |

Apply one with `levels({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Color & tone · tracked as story X3.9 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Passes:** reads only its own pixel, so it merges into the pass before it.
- **Masks:** set `effect.mask` to a texture, depth range or selection to limit where it applies; see [masks](/guide/masks).
- **Motion:** Static: nothing animates.
- **Cost:** 0.0 ms added to a 960×540 frame on CI container (SwiftShader software renderer) (2026-10-11). A software renderer: use it to compare effects, not to predict GPU times.
- **Size:** 6.9 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/levels`, including the shared effect runtime.
